title: Data Oriented GUI in Rust by Raph Levien - Bay Area Rust Meetup
summary: Raph Levien presents his new Rust GUI framework, built on data-oriented design and ideas from entity component systems, for the Xi editor. He weighs the approach against alternatives and discusses pros and cons.
why: HN people point to it as an excellent, inspirational talk on Rust GUI architecture, and it led many to the Druid project.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: I found this excellent talk to be complementary to my talk[1] on data-oriented GUI in Rust
